text.p: Gaming machine maker Aristocrat Leisure Industries Ltd said on Monday that claims against the company in a newspaper report today were unsubstantiated.

The Sydney Morning Herald reported on Monday that the Australian Stock Exchange is investigating a complaint made against Aristocrat by one of the members of the Ainsworth family, who control the comapny.

"The company has been contacted by the companies Officer of the Australian Stock Exchange regarding issues concerning the company referred to in the Sydney Morning Herald today," said executive chairman John Dougall said in a statement.
"The company believes these issues to be unsubstantiated, but is reviewing the matter," Dougall said.
At 1.20 p.m. (0220 GMT), Aristocrat shares were seven cents lower at A$2.91 with nearly 51,000 shares traded.
